title: Myna Summary Template
description: Schema for a Myna summary template: a prompt template plus an optional intended output shape.

$schema.description: Path to this schema file, for editor tooling.

name.description: Kebab-case template id; must match the template's filename (without extension).

description.description: Human-readable summary of what this template produces.

label.description: Optional short (1-2 word) display label for compact UI tabs, e.g. 'Notes'. Absent means the UI falls back to a title-cased name.

emoji.description: Optional single display emoji for compact UI tabs, e.g. '📝'. Absent means the UI falls back to a generic emoji. At most 2 Unicode scalar values (covers a plain emoji or a base character plus a variation selector).

prompt.description: Prompt template. May contain the placeholders {title}, {duration}, {transcript}, and {language}. If {language} is omitted, a directive sentence naming the requested output language is appended automatically when the prompt is rendered.

section_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the intended shape of the model's output. Not enforced on generated output; advisory only.
